page.layout: One page of text, single column. Top: page number 3 centred. Below it a decorated woodcut banner (title ornament). Then a large title block in italic and roman capitals, set in a single column, ending in a closing line. Below that, a column beginning with a large decorated initial A, followed by running text in the same column, ending with a signature mark at the foot right. No marginal notes.
page.notes: The woodcut banner at the top and the large decorative initial A are ornaments, transcribed only by their letters. The opening words "ANNVS" are set in small capitals with the first letter enlarged. The text is in a slightly faded scan; the initial word of the body paragraph is printed as "ANNVS" and is read as such. The lower-left of the column carries a smudge; no text lost there.
